cues.text: Excuse me. Would you mind if I asked you some questions? We're doing a survey on transport.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yes, that's OK.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: First of all, can I take your name?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yes. It's Sadie Jones.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: Thanks very much. And could I have your date of birth – just the year will do, actually. Is that all right?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yes, that's fine. It's 1991.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: So next your postcode, please.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: It's DW30 7YZ.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: Great. Thanks. Is that in Wells?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: No it's actually in Harborne – Wells isn't far from there, though.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: I really like that area. My grandmother lived there when I was a kid.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yes, it is nice.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: Right, so now I want to ask you some questions about how you travelled here today. Did you use public transport?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yes. I came by bus.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: OK. And that was today. It's the 24th of April, isn't it?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Isn't it the 25th? No, actually, you're right.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: Ha ha. And what was the reason for your trip today? I can see you've got some shopping with you.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yes. I did some shopping but the main reason I came here was to go to the dentist.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: That's not much fun. Hope it was nothing serious.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: No, it was just a check-up. It's fine.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: Good. Do you normally travel by bus into the city centre?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yes. I stopped driving in ages ago because parking was so difficult to find and it costs so much.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: I see.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: The bus is much more convenient too. It only takes about 30 minutes.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: That's good. So where did you start your journey?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: At the bus stop on Claxby Street.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: Is that C-L-A-X-B-Y?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: That's right.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: And how satisfied with the service are you? Do you have any complaints?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Well, as I said, it's very convenient and quick when it's on time, but this morning it was late. Only about 10 minutes, but still.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: Yes, I understand that's annoying. And what about the timetable? Do you have any comments about that?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Mmm. I suppose I mainly use the bus during the day, but any time I've been in town in the evening – for dinner or at the cinema – I've noticed you have to wait a long time for a bus – there aren't that many.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: OK, thanks. So now I'd like to ask you about your car use.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Well, I have got a car but I don't use it that often. Mainly just to go to the supermarket. But that's about it really. My husband uses it at the weekends to go to the golf club.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: And what about a bicycle?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: I don't actually have one at the moment.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: What about the city bikes you can rent? Do you ever use those?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: No – I'm not keen on cycling there because of all the pollution. But I would like to get a bike – it would be good to use it to get to work.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: So why haven't you got one now?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Well, I live in a flat – on the second floor and it doesn't have any storage – so we'd have to leave it in the hall outside the flat.
cues.speaker: SADIE

cues.text: I see. OK. Well, I think that's all …
cues.speaker: MAN
